slices.focus: Saira admits to her GP she's been anxious, sleepless, and perpetually braced
slices.summary: Saira tells her GP she has not been sleeping properly and feels constantly braced. The GP recommends a screen cutoff, headache tracking, and work counseling sessions. Saira starts implementing these, acknowledging she had stopped treating herself as a priority and was running on accumulated strain.
